title: Source Volume versus Operational Reservoir Rate
question: Does the fixed-width R6 block encoding preserve the exponential source-volume growth of SL(2,R) as operationally distinguishable one-shot information at fixed resolution?

correction_ledger.invalidated_pilot: An uncommitted tree-indexed draft was executed in the shared worktree before this correction. It counted constructed leaves, multiplied those counts by closed-form R6 success factors, and queried records at their own coordinates. It did not construct the density matrices, trace-distance codebooks, PGM receiver, or information bounds defined here.
correction_ledger.disposition: The pilot code, report, PDF, and artifacts were deleted without being staged or committed. Its constructed-count result is not evidence and is not an input to any threshold below.
scientific_correction: The split form Q_(2,2) is indefinite and is not a retrieval or packing metric.
Cartan/Haar slab volume is not an operational packing number.
N times postselection probability is a catalogue-count surrogate, not bits per attempted shot.
The source-volume exponent k cannot be varied independently on the fixed (2,2) substrate.
The R6 normalization removes the unbounded scale unless that classical side channel is explicitly retained and charged.

objects.source: Q(x)=x0^2+x1^2-x2^2-x3^2=1, identified with SL(2,R) by the existing R6 map
objects.source_coordinates: rho >= 0 and phi, psi in the two-torus
objects.source_volume: absolute induced pseudo-volume of the Cartan slab 0 <= rho <= R
objects.quantum_instrument: existing R6 fixed-width block encoding A=M/||M||_2
objects.probe: one fixed maximally entangled system-reference Bell state
objects.failure_handling: all ancilla failures are erased to one common orthogonal failure symbol
objects.codeword: rho_M = |v_A><v_A| direct-sum (1-p_M)|fail><fail|, where |v_A>=(I tensor A)|Phi+> is unnormalised and p_M=<v_A|v_A>
objects.scale_policy: The classical subnormalisation scale s=||M||_2 is excluded from the receiver. No arbitrary-precision radial side channel is free.

algorithms.deduplication: Candidates whose codeword trace distance is below 1e-10 are one operational state. In particular M and -M must be identified.
algorithms.packing_lower_bound: For each frozen order, greedily accept a candidate only when it is at least epsilon from every accepted codeword. Report every order and use their maximum only as a deterministic lower bound, never as the maximum packing number.
algorithms.small_grid_exact_control: On rho in {0,1} with two phi and two psi angles, enumerate every subset after operational deduplication and compute the exact epsilon-packing maximum.
algorithms.receiver: Pretty-good measurement for the uniform prior on each selected finite codebook.
information: I_PGM from the measured PGM confusion matrix
Holevo chi of the finite ensemble
catalogue proxy N*p_min, separately labelled A-tier and never called bits
algorithms.compact_control: Matched SU(2) Euler-family codewords with theta(rho)=2*atan(rho), the same rho/phi/psi descriptions, the same Bell probe, state dimension, attempted uses, epsilon values, and order policies.

predictions.statement: The induced metric is diag(-1,cosh(rho)^2,-sinh(rho)^2), the absolute volume density is cosh(rho)*sinh(rho), and V([0,R])=2*pi^2*sinh(R)^2 with source exponent 2.
Q_(2,2) is rejected as an operational metric: distinct Q=1 points can be null-separated.
Every finite codeword density matrix is Hermitian, positive semidefinite, trace one, reproduces the R6 Bell-probe success probability tr(A^dagger A)/2, and is invariant under M -> -M.
For every frozen epsilon, the high-depth slope [log N_epsilon(6)-log N_epsilon(4)]/2 of the best preregistered greedy lower bound is at most 0.25, far below the exact source-volume exponent 2.
For every selected codebook, 0 <= I_PGM <= chi <= I_oracle <= log2(N) within 1e-9 bits.
The catalogue proxy N*p_min and operational information are reported as distinct observables; no sign of the former is promoted to a capacity threshold.

controls.name: source Jacobian
controls.gate: Exact and finite-difference source-volume identities agree within 1e-10 away from rho=0.

controls.name: indefinite metric rejection
controls.gate: The explicit distinct null-separated pair is detected and any Q-based packing API raises an error.

controls.name: R6 binding
controls.gate: The existing R6 average success rows are reproduced within 1e-12 and the committed R6 verdict remains SURVIVES.

controls.name: density and trace-distance laws
controls.gate: Hermiticity, positivity, unit trace, symmetry, identity, and all tested triangle inequalities pass their frozen tolerances.

controls.name: global phase quotient
controls.gate: D(M,-M) <= 1e-10 for every tested source point.

controls.name: exact small packing
controls.gate: Every production greedy count on the small grid is no larger than the exact enumerated maximum.

controls.name: ordering disclosure
controls.gate: All four frozen orders and their count spread are persisted; only their maximum is called a lower bound.

controls.name: information inequalities
controls.gate: PGM rows normalise and H2 holds at every evaluated point.

controls.name: matched compact baseline
controls.gate: The SU(2) candidates use the same grid, description count, Bell probe, matrix width, and decoder.

controls.name: radial rescaling
controls.gate: Under rho'=a*rho, the source and R6 worst-cost exponents both rescale by 1/a; their comparison is not allowed to change.

verdict_rules.P: A failed exact/algebraic control voids the operational run.
verdict_rules.H1: SURVIVES only if its stated slope gate holds for all epsilon values; otherwise FALSIFIED on the frozen grid without changing the compact-closure theorem.
verdict_rules.H2: SURVIVES only if every inequality holds; any violation voids the information instrument.
verdict_rules.overall: The strongest allowed result is a finite fixed-grid operational-rate statement plus exact compactification geometry. No finite grid establishes an asymptotic Shannon capacity.

kill_conditions: Using Q_(2,2), sqrt(abs(Q)), or any signed split form as a packing or retrieval metric.
Calling Cartan/Haar volume an operational packing count.
Calling N*p, b^L, constructed addresses, or stored records bits per attempted shot.
Calling a greedy codebook the exact maximum packing number.
Varying k without a fully specified geometric and representation family with width and precision parity.
Changing epsilon, grids, candidate orders, probe, receiver, or failure handling after observing outcomes.
Retaining the unbounded classical scale s at no description or precision cost.
Mixing a fixed Bell-probe average regime with a codeword-adaptive contracting-vector regime.
Claiming quantum advantage, hardware performance, noise robustness, cognition, AGI, or a general hyperbolic-memory benefit.

evidence_ceiling.P: source geometry, fixed-width compactification, and exact finite-dimensional identities
evidence_ceiling.M: finite codebook lower bounds, finite PGM confusion matrices, and information brackets
evidence_ceiling.A: catalogue proxy and any hybrid interpretation joining source volume to R6 cost
excluded: Shannon capacity of an optimized channel

resource_budget.expected_runtime: under three minutes on one CPU core

stop_condition: Stop after focused tests, one frozen-grid execution, evidence-envelope verification, concise report, full-suite regression, privacy scan, and an attempted exact-history Git publication. Do not tune or open a new family.
